class.name: CgamePerfCapture
class.brief_description: Versioned performance capture format with regression comparison.
class.description: A capture is a plain [Dictionary] with the keys [code]magic[/code] ([code]"cgperf"[/code]), [code]version[/code], [code]label[/code], [code]created_unix[/code], [code]environment[/code], [code]scenario[/code] and the array sections [code]frames[/code], [code]trace_events[/code], [code]counters[/code], [code]memory_samples[/code], [code]streaming_events[/code] and [code]network_packets[/code]. [method write] stores it as a binary variant or as JSON when the path ends with [code].json[/code]; [method read] detects the format. The comparison helpers are noise aware: [method compare_runs] takes the median of repeated runs and widens the allowed regression by a share of the run-to-run spread, [method compare_subsystems] compares per-scope average frame cost between two captures and [method memory_leak_trend] fits a line through memory samples of a soak run. All methods are static.

method.name: add_event
method.description: Appends [param event] to an array section of [param capture]. Unknown sections are ignored.

method.name: add_frame
method.description: Appends a frame record to [param capture].

method.name: capture_environment
method.description: Returns engine version, OS, processor, core count, video adapter, rendering method and build type.

method.name: capture_from_trace
method.description: Creates a capture whose [code]frames[/code] are taken from [CgameTrace].

method.name: compare_runs
method.description: Compares the metrics [code]frame_time_p50[/code], [code]frame_time_p95[/code], [code]frame_time_p99[/code], [code]memory_peak[/code], [code]draw_calls[/code] and [code]shader_compiles[/code]. Each side is either a flat metric dictionary or [code]{"runs": [flat dictionaries]}[/code]. [param thresholds] maps a metric (or [code]"default"[/code], 10 percent) to the allowed increase in percent; [code]"noise_factor"[/code] (default 0.5) is the share of the run spread added to the limit. Returns [code]{metrics, regressions, ok}[/code].

method.name: compare_subsystems
method.description: Returns the scopes whose average per-frame cost grew by more than [param threshold_pct] between the two captures, worst first, with the keys [code]scope[/code], [code]baseline_avg[/code], [code]current_avg[/code] and [code]pct[/code].

method.name: frame_times
method.description: Returns the frame times in milliseconds.

method.name: load_json
method.description: Loads a JSON dictionary, or returns an empty dictionary if the file is missing or invalid.

method.name: memory_leak_trend
method.description: Fits a least-squares line through [param samples]. Returns [code]{slope, r2, growth_pct, samples, leak}[/code]; [code]leak[/code] is [code]true[/code] when the slope is positive, the fit reaches [param min_r2] and the total growth reaches [param min_growth_pct] of the mean.

method.name: merge
method.description: Returns a new capture with the array sections concatenated and the frames sorted by index. Environment keys and the scenario of [param base] win.

method.name: new_capture
method.description: Creates an empty capture of the current format version.

method.name: read
method.description: Reads a capture. Returns an empty dictionary if the file is missing, unreadable or not a capture.

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns human-readable problems; an empty array means the capture is valid.

method.name: write
method.description: Writes [param capture] to [param path]. Returns [code]false[/code] if the file cannot be written.

constants.constant: The capture format version written by this engine.
